notes: Joss & Main (jossandmain.com), a Wayfair-family sister storefront, has NO Pet Care department, category, or product line -- confirmed absent via multiple independent checks, not just a search test. ACCESS: direct curl_cffi impersonate=chrome131 hit PerimeterX px-captcha (429 'Access to this page has been denied') on the homepage on the very first request this session, and Playwright headless Chromium hit the identical px-captcha wall; per tier order I escalated to a real logged-in Chrome tab via mcp__claude-in-chrome (robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, generic User-agent:* rules only, and explicitly Allows /*/sb0/, /*/sb1/, /*/sb2/ leaf-category paths) which loaded the site cleanly past PerimeterX. Deeper non-homepage paths (robots.txt, sitemap XML files, keyword.php search) then also worked fine via curl_cffi without further blocks, so tier-1 was used for the rest of the session. CHECKS PERFORMED: (1) Full mega-nav scraped from the live rendered homepage via Chrome (get_page_text) -- top-level departments are only Furniture, Outdoor, Lighting, Decor & Pillows, Wall Decor & Mirrors, Rugs, Bedding, Bath, Kitchen & Tabletop, Storage, Reno, Sale; the entire flattened nav text (~400 category/link labels) contains zero occurrences of Pet/Pets/Dog/Cat as a category branch. (2) Fetched the site's own category sitemaps directly: seo-category-sitemap~0.xml (166 mid-level /cat/ URLs, confirmed single-page via the sitemap index) and seo-sb0-sitemap~0.xml (191 leaf /sb0/ URLs, confirmed complete -- requesting ~1.xml returned 404) -- grepped both for pet|dog|cat-|kennel|crate|leash|litter|scratch (case-insensitive): zero matches in either. (3) Site keyword search for 'pet' (keyword.php?keyword=pet) returned totalSKUCount=11, noResult=FALSE, but inspecting the actual returned SKUs' marketingCopy shows they are area rugs whose fiber is 'PET' (polyester, a material abbreviation) or described as 'pet-friendly' (durability marketing) -- not pet products. (4) Site keyword search for 'dog bed' (keyword.php?keyword=dog+bed) returned totalSKUCount=58, noResult=FALSE, but the returned SKUs' marketingCopy is overwhelmingly human bedroom furniture (upholstered beds, headboards, benches), sofas, pillows, and two unrelated holiday tree ornaments ('felt pup ornament', 'Pug Christmas ornament' -- pet-themed decor, excluded per brief, not pet care) -- i.e. a non-discriminating keyword-match fallback (matching on the word 'bed'), not a genuine pet-bed product line. No dedicated /pets/, /dog/, or /cat/ URL path segment exists anywhere in the sitemap or nav. Conclusion: Joss & Main sells home furniture/decor only and carries no Pet Care assortment as of 2026-09-02; this is independently derived from the prior Home-Decor pass's own conclusion (which also never surfaced a Pet department while enumerating all other departments) and is NOT assumed to mirror Wayfair (S.N. 1) or any other Wayfair-family sibling.
